title: Streets of Rage 4
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#322, 2026-10-05), Apple M1, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.6 beta, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r21, D3DMetal, rated 5 of 5 after starting it, opening every menu and getting in game at 1920x1080. Not verified by the maintainer. After 18 minutes of play the same player revised it to playable but not stable: crashes at loading screens.
notes: Starts and plays on D3DMetal on the default engine on an M1 at 1920x1080, but crashes at some loading screens (the spinning star in the corner), first on opening Extras and then at the first big load of stage 2, with a .NET InvalidDataException in the game ('The archive entry was compressed using an unsupported compression method') and a page fault at the same address each time. The game's files verified intact in Steam. The exception comes from .NET's zip reading, which under Wine is Wine's Mono unless Microsoft's .NET Framework is installed in the environment; whether installing .NET Framework 4.8 cures it is being tested (highball-db#322).

knownIssues.symptom: Crashes at some loading screens, with 'The archive entry was compressed using an unsupported compression method'
knownIssues.cause: suspected Wine's Mono reading the game's archives where Microsoft's .NET would; not confirmed
knownIssues.fix: to try: Settings, Environments, the environment, Windows components, add .NET Framework 4.8 (highball-db#322)
